threads.label: Your treasure map
threads.text: It brought you to Brandonsford. You still don't know where its places are, or which one holds the treasure.

threads.label: The dragon bounty
threads.text: Eric the Reeve offers a thousand gold for the black dragon's body, though Sir Phidipaldi slapped him and challenged him to a duel. Lady Hilda will join the hunt if paid.

threads.label: The Clurichen
threads.text: Reginald, a frog, warned Dr. Uriah that this trickster comes into town every night.

threads.label: Bentley's missing shipment
threads.text: Nothing has arrived for him in months, and no one yet knows why.

threads.label: Drop Dead Ned
threads.text: This thief offered to hire on with Dr. Uriah, killer wasp and all, if paid. Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.

threads.label: Quinn's vanishing ale
threads.text: Quinn, who runs the Golden Egg, offers Sir Phidipaldi a hundred gold to catch whoever or whatever empties his good ale each night.

threads.label: Dunk's night with Farmer Gill
threads.text: Over drinks, Gill told him the legend of Sir Brandon slaying a dragon.

closing: Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn are in the empty Golden Egg, about to fill bottles with water and stage a showy fake ale delivery. Wayman and Dr. Uriah are across the street in the Clumsy Fox. Dunk is staying the night in Farmer Gill's barn on the edge of town.
